Docs.summary: The specific date range of cost details requested for the report. This parameter cannot be used alongside either the invoiceId or billingPeriod parameters. If a timePeriod, invoiceId or billingPeriod parameter is not provided in the request body the API will return the current month's cost. API only allows data to be pulled for 1 month or less and no older than 13 months. If no timePeriod or billingPeriod or invoiceId is provided the API defaults to the open month time period.
